"e50acc57-5eee-5203-9dd8-5e7531f41fa1" :question/id #uuid "e50acc57-5eee-5203-9dd8-5e7531f41fa1" :question/problem "Which of the following improper integrals are divergent?
- **I.** ${\int }_{2}^{\infty }\frac{1}{\sqrt{x-1}}\,\text{d}x$
- **II.** ${\int }_{-\infty }^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x$
- **III.** ${\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x$

Select all that apply." :question/worked-solution "Let's work out each integral.

For the first integral, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{2}^{\infty }\frac{1}{\sqrt{x-1}}\,\text{d}x & ={lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{2}^{a}\frac{1}{\sqrt{x-1}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={lim}_{a\to \infty }{[2\sqrt{x-1}]}_{2}^{a} \\  & ={lim}_{a\to \infty }(2\sqrt{a-1}-2\sqrt{2-1}) \\  & ={lim}_{a\to \infty }(2\sqrt{a-1}-2) \\  & =\infty ,\end{aligned}
$$

so the integral diverges.

For the second integral, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-\infty }^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x & ={lim}_{a\to -\infty }{\int }_{a}^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={lim}_{a\to -\infty }{[\operatorname{ln}⁡|x|]}_{a}^{-1} \\  & ={lim}_{a\to -\infty }(\operatorname{ln}⁡|-1|-\operatorname{ln}⁡|a|) \\  & =-\infty ,\end{aligned}
$$

so the integral diverges.

For the third integral, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x & ={lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{1}^{a}\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={lim}_{a\to \infty }{[-\frac{1}{x}]}_{1}^{a} \\  & ={lim}_{a\to \infty }(-\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{1}) \\  & =1,\end{aligned}
$$

so the integral is convergent.

In conclusion, only integrals I and II are divergent." :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["9525a6e4-2431-55ce-91b6-40d7a688e4cf" "23c3cc50-8f49-5f0a-a0d2-109c1fb2b62f" "b5ca4e79-9a78-5e09-ad2e-1b4358963f5c"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "4153fd36-4e27-5567-b96f-e7f283d02624" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186083201.py"} [:db/add 17592186083201 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] {:db/id 17592186083201 :knowledge-point/questions ["e50acc57-5eee-5203-9dd8-5e7531f41fa1"]} [:db/ensure 17592186083201 :knowledge-point/validate]]
